// REQ: LANG-1921 LANG-1922 LANG-1923 LANG-1924
Module: greeter
/* Block comment */
define class <greeter> (<object>)
  slot name :: <string> = "world", init-keyword: name:;
end class;
define method greet (g :: <greeter>, times :: <integer>) => ()
  for (i from 1 to times)
    format-out("Hello, %s!\n", g.name);
  end for;
end method;
greet(make(<greeter>, name: "dylan"), 2);
